llama_cpp.source_title: Performance of llama.cpp on Nvidia CUDA (discussion opened Aug 1, 2025)

gaudi.source_title: Intel: Model Performance Data for Intel Gaudi 2 AI Accelerators, inference, Max Throughput table (page metadata last-modified 2025-05-05)
gaudi.software: Intel Gaudi software v1.20.0, PyTorch 2.6.0, Optimum-Habana, Hugging Face model
gaudi.kv_precision_note: The page does not state the KV cache type. FP8 is assumed because at batch 512 x 2176 tokens a 16-bit KV cache would need 146 GB, more than the card's 96 GB, so these runs cannot be using a 16-bit cache.
gaudi.throughput_note: Throughput is reported as tokens per second; the page does not define it further. It is compared here with generated tokens / (prefill + all decode steps).
